Meera: Heads-up: saw intermittent warmup stalls on canary when the bundle composer gzips safetensors during publish. Symptoms: repeated small-range 206 responses and downstream checksum mismatch.
infra-bot: [alert] warmup-read-flapping model=translate-xl shard=part-3
Alex: we've observed similar in other clusters. Are we verifying pre- or post-decompress?
Meera: post-decompress currently. If the range cut splits gzip header, decompressor returns weird bytes -> checksum mismatch.
Dmitri: short-term fix I tried: increase priming read to 128k and mark as elastic. Repro: serve a gzipped shard where header bytes live at offset ~500 and smaller priming hits header-split; elastic prime fixed it.
Meera: Elastic prime flow: on first checksum mismatch, do a single larger read (configurable upper bound) then reverify. If that fails, fall back to store-verify approach (fetch whole compressed object).
Alex: metadata change: manifest field `compression: "gzip"` and `compressed_size`, `compressed_sha256` optional. If compressed_sha256 present, loader should verify compressed bytes first and skip elastic prime.
Dmitri: note: some CDNs rewrap objects in different chunking which can still cause header splits; compressed_sha256 is reliable only if object bytes are preserved end-to-end.
Meera: telemetry we need: `warmup.gz_header_split`, `warmup.gz_elastic_trigger`, `warmup.gz_compressed_verify_success`. Tags for model/shard/region.
Alex: tests: simulated HTTP server that supports range and intentional header-split injection. Unit tests for decompressing partial streams should be added.
Dmitri: long-term: introduce a small sidecar index mapping compressed-chunk checksums so we can validate partial ranges. Might be an optional index file generated at publish time.
Meera: ownership: Alex -> loader changes + tests, Priya (cc'd) -> manifest schema PR; Dmitri -> storage/CDN guidance + test harness. I'll create followup ticket INF-8750 with rollout plan.
infra-bot: created ticket INF-8750 "elastic gz priming + compressed checksum manifest"
Meera: thanks, will sync on daily if canary repeats. :raised_hands:
